name: saydianapp-server
description: Saydian App modular backend, worker, admin, compatibility API and migration tools

scripts.tools:test: node --test tools/tooling.test.mjs && pnpm test:h5:flows && pnpm test:h5:contracts
scripts.test:h5:contracts: node tools/build-global-h5.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tools/api-global-commerce-contracts.test.mjs tools/h5-field-contracts.test.mjs tools/h5-global-commerce-integration.test.mjs tools/h5-isolated-integration.test.mjs tools/h5-browser-fixture.test.mjs tools/h5-catalog-ui-fixture.test.mjs tools/h5-demo-network-guard.test.cjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @saydian/app-contracts build && pnpm --filter @saydian/commerce-domain build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @saydian/app-contracts build && pnpm --filter @saydian/commerce-domain build && pnpm -r --if-present test
